# MESA KU

> Mechanical Engineering Students Association at Kenyatta University — engineering projects, workshops, industrial visits, competitions, and student leadership.

## Pages

- [Home](/): About MESA KU, executive board, sponsors, and how to get involved.
- [Events](/events): Upcoming workshops, talks, competitions, and industrial visits.
- [Announcements](/announcements): News and updates from MESA KU.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos from past events and activities.
